purpose: Determine whether the P0662 registered dwarf instability is physical or caused by aliasing in point-sampled downscaling, using a conservative common-resolution comparison while leaving primary candidate scores unchanged.
constitutive_equation: unchanged from P0662: div[mu ((1-sigma) I + sigma n_hat n_hat) grad Phi] = 4 pi G rho_b

definitions.sigma: unchanged P0662 physical-length quadratic tensor coefficient
definitions.common_resolution_rule: before grid comparison only, convolve the native surface-density maps by the Gaussian required to reach an effective sigma of one-half target pixel, then evaluate both the filtered native grid and its conservatively sampled coarse grid
definitions.mass_conservation: renormalize the sampled surface density so its physical integral equals the filtered native-map integral

selection_rule: The P0662 candidate advances only if the conservative common-resolution audit passes every gate. The native activation scores must reproduce P0662 exactly; smoothing may not be used to improve the primary domain score.
claim_boundary: P0663 corrects a validation measurement operator; it does not modify the gravity law or its primary scores.
A pass would authorize outcome-blind real-map field solves, not observational claims.
Actual future predictions must propagate each instrument's measured beam or PSF rather than infer it from a target outcome.
No P0633 velocity, P0640 lens constraint, or spent lens residual may be used in P0663 development or selection.
